description: Net yearly CHF effect of moving between two Swiss communes for one household: live commune-level tax (official ESTV 2026) plus canton-average rent and health-premium differences; positive savings = the move saves money. For the full move checklist (insurer, school holidays, electricity, permits, deadlines) use plan_move.

children.description: Number of children in the household, e.g. 2 (default 0).

married.description: true for a married couple (joint taxation), false or omitted for a single person.

name: estimate_net_move
title: Net cost of a move
